body.p: After . Owns include/sxml/xslt.h. A compiled stylesheet (lifecycle quintet, ) from bytes or from the resolver (XSLT_MODULE, XSLT_PACKAGE of 2.2) with static parameters; a transformation request: initial mode, template (default xsl:initial-template) or function, global context item, stylesheet parameters, primary result as a sequence, a tree or serialized by its output definition (3.0 parameters), a result-document handler (absolute href to an sxml_output_stream or a tree; statuses), the message sink of 2.2 (terminate raises XTMM9000). Done when header check, lints and rubric pass and 4.1 and 4.15 can be written against it. Done 2026-10-17 (): include/sxml/xslt.h, header only: sxml_xslt_stylesheet (quintet; text, XSLT_MODULE or XSLT_PACKAGE; static parameters), sxml_xslt_output_definition, sxml_xslt_stylesheet_transform with the three invocation kinds, sxml_xslt_result_delivery, the result document handler and its default, sxml_xslt_result_document_collector (for 4.15 to implement).
